Name: Vienna - Dark Roast
Desc:
The darkest roast from us , this blend has coffee beans from Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, has high body, low acidity, and is a excellent choice for people who want to have  a strong cup, with the characteristic bittersweet notes. The Vienna Roast is best enjoyed with milk.  
  The beans have been roasted to the higher side of medium to bring out the notes of roasted hazelnut, dark chocolate, and Raisin. This one is perfect for Espresso-based drinks, French Press, and other immersion brews.

Name: Boss's Wife - House Blend
Desc:
Introducing Savorworks's House Blend: crafted with love, humor, and admiration for the women who keep everything running smoothly and beautifully impressive.  
 It all started with a charming moment when the founders were dating, one asked, “If you were a coffee, what would you be?”. She said, “An espresso because it’s sweet, blends effortlessly with everyone." 
 Inspired by her beautiful answer and appreciating the woman of the house, this flagship blend has been everyone’s favorite since 2020. Crafted to charm the sensory journey of rich, complex, sweet, and versatile. Whether you prefer a strong, flavorful black coffee or a creamy, bold, and balanced latte that’s never overshadowed by the milk and leaving a long-lasting aftertaste. It’s the perfect specialty coffee for every occasion and method.  
 Taste Savorworks specialty coffee blend and celebrate the incredible women who make every house and organization extraordinary. Named after the true boss (Boss's Wife), the woman who makes everything just right. This is a toast to women out there. 
   
  Blend:  Washed and Anaerobic Black Honey 
  Estate:  Ratnagiri Estate & Riverdale Estate 
  Tasting Notes : Peach, Jaggery, Roasted Almond, Dark Chocolate 
    Roast Level : Medium

Name: Coffee Drip Kit - Nutty & Chocolaty
Tasting_Notes: Say goodbye to bitterness and embrace a delightful coffee experience that highlights nutty undertones and luscious
Origin: Sourced from the esteemed Riverdale Estate
Desc:
Introducing the Savorworks Coffee Drip Kit —expertly crafted for both coffee enthusiasts and first-time black coffee explorers who crave authentic, natural flavors from an excellent brew. Say goodbye to bitterness and embrace a delightful coffee experience that highlights nutty undertones and luscious chocolatey notes, all without the need for sugar. For those who prefer a creamier texture, it’s also delightful with a pour of milk. 
 This innovative drip kit features specialty Arabica coffee sourced from the renowned Riverdale Estate, roasted and ground to perfection. Enjoy the same remarkable quality as manual pour-over brewing, but with added convenience—no kettles, thermometers, grinders, or scales required. Simply unfold the filter, pour hot water, and savor a beautifully classic black coffee in just a few minutes. 
 Features: 
 
 
 Premium Ingredients:    100% Specialty Arabica Coffee, nitrogen-flushed to lock in freshness. 
 
 Origin:    Sourced from the esteemed Riverdale Estate. 
 
 Roast Profile:    Medium dark roast for a rich, robust flavor with nutty undertones and luscious chocolatey notes. 
 
 Versatile Enjoyment:    Perfect as a black coffee or with a splash of milk for added creaminess. 
 
 Convenient Packaging:    Each kit includes 5 individual 12g servings (60g total), perfect for on-the-go brewing. 
 
 Storage Tips:    Preserve freshness by storing in a cool, dry, and dark place. 
 
 Unlock the world of flavorful black coffee with the Savorworks Coffee Drip Kit—your gateway to an enjoyable and rich coffee journey wherever life takes you. Perfect for any setting, this kit ensures that you can appreciate the craft of coffee making effortlessly. Enjoy your coffee, your way!
